question: Does the corpus have a term for SUFY's free local and persistent storage when no free compute time is given, and for a one-time-but-expiring credit that is not a recurring allowance?
why: SUFY's only free quantity is 20 GiB local storage per sandbox and 10 GiB persistent storage per account per month; compute is billed from the first second, so verdict is paid-only. box by Simular's 5,000 credits are one-time and valid 90 days, so verdict is trial-only; neither free_tier.unit nor verdict has a dedicated term for these shapes.
